project_type: Python IDP (intelligent document processing) pipeline: Layer 1 inspect -> Layer 1.5 probe -> Layer 2 conversion (Docling/PaddleOCR/VLM) -> Layer 3 extraction. Library + AWS Lambda handlers; local-only for this task (NO AWS, NO deploy).
build_system: No packaging build step; pure Python package under src/. Use the repo venv interpreter directly: c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\IDP\engineer_a\.venv\Scripts\python.exe
test_framework: pytest (pytest 9.1.1). Tests live in tests/. No pytest.ini/pyproject config; the @pytest.mark.slow marker is unregistered (emits a harmless PytestUnknownMarkWarning) and is used to tag the one real-model test.
build_command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import src.ai.layer1_probe.probe, src.ai.layer1_routing.pipeline, src.ai.layer2_conversion.scanned, src.config.settings"  (import-smoke; there is no compile step)
verification_instructions: ALWAYS use the repo venv python (.venv\Scripts\python.exe) for every python/pytest invocation. Run the targeted probe/pipeline suites per feature first, then the full fast suite. Do NOT run the real-engine local tests (tests/test_layer2_engines_local.py::*_engine_local_path -> real Docling/Paddle) and do NOT run @pytest.mark.slow (tests/test_probe_linewise.py::test_label_mapping_real_fp32_optional). Baseline probe+pipeline suites (tests/test_probe.py + tests/test_pipeline_probe_integration.py + tests/test_probe_linewise.py + tests/test_probe_script_onnx.py) collect 57 tests; the slow one skips without the model.
environment_constraints: NO AWS calls, NO torch, NO paddleocr, NO real Bedrock. Mock the Bedrock/VLM client, the Paddle Lambda invoke, and the probe ONNX observer in all tests. Never stage/commit/track/delete any .onnx file. Never edit docker/ or step_functions/. Do not touch src/api/lambda_probe_handler.py. Never git commit or stage. Windows PowerShell shell; quote paths.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md mandates 3 AWS resource tags when provisioning AWS resources (createdby=vinay.k@shellkode, purpose=internal, customer=idp-internal-35385) -- NOT relevant to this local, no-AWS task (no resources are created). Edits ALLOWED ONLY in: src/ai/layer1_routing/pipeline.py, src/ai/layer2_conversion/scanned.py, src/config/settings.py (one flag only), src/ai/layer1_probe/* and NEW test files. Nothing else.
key_patterns: settings uses pydantic-settings BaseSettings with env_prefix='IDP_' so a field probe_enabled maps to IDP_PROBE_ENABLED automatically (template flags: enable_vlm_direct, paddle_prefer_lambda). RouteChoice.route is ALREADY an engine-name string (skip, paddleocr_printed, paddleocr_handwritten, vlm_transcribe) -- use directly as EngineTask.engine; do NOT remap through pipeline._ROUTE_TO_ENGINE (whose keys are Layer-1 vocab digital/scanned/handwritten). needs_probe(profile_dict, given_route, cfg) takes a profile DICT (use profile.model_dump()). ProbeConfig.from_env() reads IDP_PROBE_* knobs (n_samples default 3, max_samples 6, vlm_for_handwriting True). The lipika-vs-vlm telemetry (logger.info 'probe.lipika_vs_vlm') and VLM-overrides-confident-latin rule live in probe.py _observe and MUST stay in the shared core. ocr_lang is already threaded through _invoke_paddle_lambda/_ocr_convert/convert_scanned_page/convert_handwritten_via_paddle and the payload adds 'ocr_lang' only when truthy -- do NOT touch that; only _get_paddle_engine lacks per-lang caching.
